directionReason: Hand-thrown ceramics sit best on warm paper and quiet serif type, like a catalogue printed on good stock.
tagline: Tableware thrown by hand in small runs
metaDescription: MERIDIAN CLAY is a commerce concept: hand-thrown stoneware plates, bowls and cups made in small runs.

hero.sub: Stoneware plates, bowls and cups, thrown by hand in runs of fifty and glazed to age well.

statement: Every piece is *thrown, trimmed and glazed by hand*, so no two are quite the same, and all of them go in the dishwasher.

collection.title: The everyday set
collection.intro: Four forms, two glazes, made to mix.

products.name: Dinner Plate
products.desc: A wide, shallow plate with a raised rim that keeps sauces where they belong.

products.name: Pasta Bowl
products.desc: Low and generous, for pasta, salads and anything with a broth.

products.name: Side Plate
products.desc: For bread, small plates and the last piece of cake.

products.name: Morning Cup
products.desc: A handle-less cup that sits warm in two hands.

steps.title: Thrown on the wheel
steps.body: Each form is thrown from the same weighed ball of clay, so a set feels like a set.

steps.title: Glazed by dipping
steps.body: Two glazes, mixed in the studio, applied by hand so they pool and break at the rim.

steps.title: Fired twice
steps.body: A slow bisque, then a high stoneware firing that makes every piece strong enough for daily use.

values.title: Small runs
values.body: Fifty of each form at a time, so nothing sits in a warehouse.

values.title: Made to use
values.body: Every piece is dishwasher safe and built for daily meals.

values.title: Honest glazes
values.body: Food-safe, lead-free and tested in the studio.

newsletter.title: News from the studio.
newsletter.body: New glazes, studio sales and the next firing.
